isana: Weird one — publish blocked after a regen. I only reran typegen but changeloggen added a breaking note about a default value change? I didn't touch defaults. Anyone seen default/optional ordering trigger changelog heuristics?
leo: paste the diff if you can.
isana: tiny snip: ```diff
- func ProvisionNode(ctx context.Context, name string, region string, opts *ProvisionOpts) (*Node, error)
+ func ProvisionNode(ctx context.Context, region string, opts *ProvisionOpts, name string) (*Node, error)
```
marta: hmm that's a reorder but changeloggen says "default value introduced on parameter 'name'" which is bogus. looks like the generator started treating a previously positional-only param as optional (pointer type) and that confused the changelog comparator.
regen-bot: regen-report: file: sdk/go/nodes.gen.go, changes: 1, classification: signature-diff + default-change, release-gate: BLOCKED
ci-bot: pipeline: typegen-check failed (exit 3) - regen diff non-empty. full log: "changelog-diff: detected default value on parameter name; semver: major"
leo: two angles: 1) fix generator to preserve explicit optionality metadata; 2) fix changelog comparator to verify actual default literals rather than inferring from pointer/nullable types.
isana: i checked the openapi: parameter 'name' had no default before and none now. generator must have altered the parameter representation when computing Go types.
marta: we also recently updated typegen to prefer pointers for optional structs; this accidentally changed how the changelog heuristics parse "optional" -> they treat pointer as defaultable. i'll push a small mapping fix.
regen-bot: suggestion: mark diffs that only reorder parameters and only toggle pointer vs non-pointer for optional wrapper as "reorder-or-optional-wrapper" and treat them as non-breaking until manual review.
leo: short-term workaround: run `make typegen-stable` with a toggle to keep the previous optionality mapping: `TYPEGEN_OPTIONAL_POLICY=legacy make typegen-stable` and commit. long-term: update generator mapping and changelog comparator.
isana: ran local change: `TYPEGEN_OPTIONAL_POLICY=legacy make typegen-stable && git commit -m "regen: preserve legacy optional mapping to avoid false defaults"` -> output: "diff empty"
ci-bot: re-run: typegen-check PASS, release-gate PASS. publish resumed.
marta: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/624 - restores legacy optional mapping and adds unit tests around default detection. also opened changelog PR to check concrete default values rather than type-based heuristics: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/92
leo: related note: go-sdk had an auth/retry flaky test that broke because header canonicalization changed when switching pointer wrapper types; i'll add a small normalization step in the test harness to avoid spurious diffs.
isana: thanks all. closing this thread after publish. :tada:
regen-bot: note: changelog heuristics will be updated in the next release to require explicit default literals for default-change classification.
